lines.text: Is the rain big or hard?
Many learners say: It is raining very big.
Better: It is raining very hard.
Hard! It rained hard last night.

native.tip: Tiếng Việt nói “mưa to”, nên dễ thành “rain big”, nhưng tiếng Anh nói “rain hard.”
native.caption: Bạn có hay nói “It is raining very big.” không? 🌧️ Tiếng Anh dùng “hard” cho mưa to: “It is raining very hard.” Nghe thầy Carlos đọc rồi lặp lại nhé! Luyện thêm trong app Lexkite.
native.comment: Đáp án: “It rained hard last night.” Hãy nói to một câu về cơn mưa gần đây, có “hard” nhé. Luyện thêm miễn phí tại đây: {link}

en.tip: Vietnamese says “mưa to”, so “rain big” is easy to say, but English says “rain hard.”
en.caption: Do you often say this? “It is raining very big.” English uses “hard” for heavy rain: “It is raining very hard.” Listen to Carlos read it, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
